hooks.command:
bash -c '
STAMP="${HOME}/.claude/github_scan.timestamp"
RESULTS="${HOME}/.claude/github_scan.md"
NOW=$(date +%s)
LAST=$(cat "$STAMP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
[ $((NOW - LAST)) -lt 86400 ] && exit 0
echo $NOW > "$STAMP"
{
  echo "# GitHub Scan $(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
  echo ""
  echo "## OpenRGB Plugins & Tools"
  curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=openrgb+plugin&sort=updated&per_page=5" \
    | python3 -c "import json,sys; items=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"items\",[]); [print(\"- [\"+r[\"full_name\"]+\"](\"+r[\"html_url\"]+\") — \"+str(r.get(\"description\") or \"\")) for r in items]"
  echo ""
  echo "## 3DS Max RGB / Lighting"
  curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=3dsmax+rgb+OR+3ds-max+lighting+OR+maxscript+rgb&sort=updated&per_page=5" \
    | python3 -c "import json,sys; items=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"items\",[]); [print(\"- [\"+r[\"full_name\"]+\"](\"+r[\"html_url\"]+\") — \"+str(r.get(\"description\") or \"\")) for r in items]"
  echo ""
  echo "## Unreal Engine RGB / Peripheral Lighting"
  curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=unreal+openrgb+OR+ue5+rgb+peripheral+OR+unreal+lighting+plugin&sort=updated&per_page=5" \
    | python3 -c "import json,sys; items=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"items\",[]); [print(\"- [\"+r[\"full_name\"]+\"](\"+r[\"html_url\"]+\") — \"+str(r.get(\"description\") or \"\")) for r in items]"
  echo ""
  echo "## OpenRGB Python SDK Updates"
  curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=openrgb+python&sort=updated&per_page=5" \
    | python3 -c "import json,sys; items=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"items\",[]); [print(\"- [\"+r[\"full_name\"]+\"](\"+r[\"html_url\"]+\") — \"+str(r.get(\"description\") or \"\")) for r in items]"
} > "$RESULTS" 2>/dev/null
echo "[Claude] Daily GitHub scan complete → ${RESULTS}"
'
